people.name: Heldai
people.line: A returned exile who helped crown Joshua.

people.name: Jedaiah
people.line: Returned exile who provided silver and gold for crowns

people.name: Josiah
people.line: One who provided silver and gold for a crown

people.name: Tobijah
people.line: Postexilic Jew who provided silver and gold for crowns

people.name: Zephaniah
people.line: One of the men in Zechariah's prophecy

translations.web: The crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.
translations.bsb: The crown will reside in the temple of the LORD as a memorial to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and the gracious son of Zephaniah.
translations.kjv: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD.
translations.asv: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of Jehovah.
